title: “We’ve lost 20 years of growth”: Australian ELICOS and VET sectors hit out at visa policy

title: ‘Not an Australia alternative’: New Zealand’s international ed sector is going for growth

title: US ELT hit by 14% student drop and shorter stays

title_cn: US ELT hit by 14% student drop and shorter stays

title: The PIE Live Asia Pacific 2026: Insights from Julian Hill MP
summary_en: Speaking at The PIE Live Asia Pacific, Hill tackles social licence and market concentration, warning that when 60–70% of students come from one country it’s bad for student experience, social licence, soft power and business risk. He also points to recent government action including the suspension of new VET/ELICOS entrants and and argues that the sector has largely backed these measures.
